w03-light-and-dark-bags-close.observed_description: Four people in white T-shirts stand close to the camera on the park grass, each holding a big plain tote bag at chest height; from left to right the bags are light sky blue, deep navy, pale mint green and deep forest green; light against dark reads at once at 180 px.
w03-light-and-dark-bags-close.note: Accepted: Her bag is light blue. / His bag is dark blue. / Her bag is light green. / His bag is dark green.

w04-taller-and-older-close.observed_description: On the park grass, a tall young man in a green T-shirt stands beside a short young woman in a red dress (left pair); after a gap, a white-haired grandfather in a beige cardigan holds the hand of a small boy in an orange T-shirt (right pair); all seen from head to shoes, each about two fifths of the photo height.
w04-taller-and-older-close.note: Accepted: The man is taller than the woman. / The woman is shorter than the man. / The grandfather is older than the boy. / The boy is younger than the grandfather.

w05-park-rules-close.observed_description: By the park lake, from left to right: a boy swims near the shore, a girl stands at a low white wall covered in chalk swirls, a sun and a flower (no letters), a man sits on top of a picnic table with his shoes on the bench, and two boys play football with a black-and-white ball; the people are small but spread out, so each target can include its lake, wall, table or ball.
w05-park-rules-close.note: Accepted: Don't swim in the lake. / Don't write on the wall. / Don't sit on the table. / Don't play football here. Targets include their setting.
